LESSON: PROTOCOLS IN SANATAN DHARMA • ARTI & CIRCUMBULATION (PARIKRAMA/ PARKARMA)

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Religious Practices
Topic 4.1: Protocols in Sanatan Dharma • Arti & Circumbulation (Parikrama/ Parkarma)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Protocols in Sanatan Dharma • Arti & Circumbulation (Parikrama/ Parkarma), part of Religious Practices in Grade 8 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why are protocols important in religious practices?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. visit places of worship for the Sanatan Dharma, accompanied by parents/guardians, to observe, record with digital devices/ adapted digital devices to present in class the relevance of Arti, its components and significance,
2. perform the Arti at the end of their presentation, individually or in groups,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Protocols in Sanatan Dharma • Arti & Circumbulation (Parikrama/ Parkarma) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: The learner enhances self-awareness and planning skills when engaging in roleplaying the mandatory religious

practices in groups.

● Digital literacy: The learner enhances digital skills while manipulating digital devices to conduct and record an interview

with resource persons on mandatory protocols in places of worship.

Values:
Respect: The learner develops open mindedness when visiting a place of worship to note the etiquettes observed.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Citizenship: The learner enhances social cohesion when re-enacting the dos and don’ts of religious etiquette observed at places

of worship.

Link to other subjects:

• The learner can relate to the skills of role playing the mandatory religious practices to the skills of role playing learnt in

Creative Arts & Sports.

• The learner can relate to the skills of recording using digital devices/digital devices with assistive technology to the skills

of using digital devices learnt in Computer Science.
